title: Senior IT Engineer

Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. Learn more at .

Senior IT Engineer

Bonus Points

title: Principal Engineer - Game Innovation
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Backed by a brand known the world over for gaming, entertainment, and hospitality, we operate like a fast-moving startup with a passion for building products millions of people play.
Our Games Studio is building the next generation of in-house casino content, and we are changing how that content gets made. We are building an AI-assisted development pipeline to design, build, and ship real-money games faster, and using it to go after formats the floor is not saturated with: Crash, Plinko, Mines, arcade-style games, skill-adjacent experiences, and formats that have not been invented yet. Two things at once: a new method for making all our games, and new kinds of games to make with it.
What's the position?
We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Game Innovation to be the technical lead for this effort. You will design and stand up the AI-assisted game development pipeline, own the architecture that takes a game from concept to a certified title live on our RGS, and build games on it yourself. You will pair with the Senior Producer, Game Innovation, who owns the product and the roadmap, while you own the technology and the build.
This is a hands-on principal role, not a management track. You will write code, make the architectural calls, and set the engineering standard for how AI-built games get produced and shipped in a regulated environment. The first question, can AI build a game, is already answered by working prototypes. The harder question is whether we can build a real framework that produces games we would put in front of real players for real money. That is your problem to solve.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the pipeline. Design and build the AI-assisted game development pipeline: a shared project with version control and CI/CD, agents that produce math, art, sound, and animation from a structured brief, automated evaluation gates, and a playable build the team can open from a link. Make it repeatable, so the second game is faster than the first.

• Own the architecture, front end to back end. Set the architecture for the game client and the back-end game server, including the round lifecycle, bet validation, outcome mapping against a certified RNG, wallet operations, reconciliation, RTP reporting, and the audit trail. Keep the math and the money server side.

• Integrate with our RGS. Lead the integration to Fingenuity, our RGS and RNG, and own the path that turns a candidate build into a certifiable, shippable title across jurisdictions.

• Build games, not just infrastructure. Stay hands-on. Prototype mechanics, build game clients and servers, and prove the pipeline by shipping real titles through it.

• Set the AI engineering standard. Define how we use AI-assisted tools and agents in game development: the conventions, the guardrails, the human review gates, and the automated checks that verify AI output before it advances. Nothing AI-generated ships uninspected.

• Choose the stack. Make the build, buy, and partner calls on engine, tooling, and infrastructure, and standardize the studio on choices that are strong for AI-assisted development and support the client and server model.

• Partner across the business. Work with platform engineering, compliance, and our RGS and third-party partners. Bring the studio's math, art, and production talent along, and keep the bar high on quality and speed.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers who join this effort, establish the code review culture, and document the patterns so the pipeline outlives any one person.

Requirements
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a builder at principal level who wants to invent the way games get made, not maintain someone else's system. Someone who has shipped real-money games, understands what certification actually demands, and is genuinely excited about what AI does to the economics

title: Customer Service to UX Research Career Changer
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: M&A-Manager (m/w/d)
description:
deine aufgaben
Für den Ausbau unserer M&A-Aktivitäten suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit 4-8 Jahren Erfahrung in M&A oder Corporate Development. Du identifizierst passende Unternehmen, baust nachhaltige Sourcing-Pipelines auf und begleitest Transaktionen vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Closing. Besonders wichtig ist uns Erfahrung im Umgang mit gründergeführten Small Caps.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du baust eine strukturierte Longlist potenzieller Zielunternehmen auf und entwickelst eine verlässliche Sourcing-Kadenz - mit einer Zielgröße von rund 250 Ansprachen pro Jahr.

• Du recherchierst und priorisierst Unternehmen anhand strategischer und finanzieller Kriterien.

• Du verantwortest die Erstansprache und führst einen wertschätzenden, vertrauensvollen Dialog mit Gründerinnen und Gründern.

• Du steuerst Transaktionsprozesse end-to-end - von der Kontaktaufnahme über NDA und LOI bis zum Closing.

• Du koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte und einen verlässlichen Prozessfortschritt.

• Du erstellst prägnante 2-Pager, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Unterlagen für Beiratssitzungen.

• Du hältst Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Prozessstatus transparent nach und leitest daraus Prioritäten für das weitere Sourcing ab.

dein profil

• 4-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in M&A, Corporate Development, Transaction Advisory oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anbahnung und Durchführung von Transaktionen.

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit gründergeführten Small Caps und ein gutes Gespür für die Perspektive von Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern.

• Sicherheit in der Recherche und Bewertung potenzieller Zielunternehmen sowie in der strukturierten Pflege einer M&A-Pipeline.

• Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten - besonders in der Erstansprache und im persönlichen Gründerdialog.

• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen schnell zu erfassen und in prägnanten 2-Pagern und Entscheidungsvorlagen aufzubereiten.

• Eine eigenständige, verbindliche und diskrete Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Organisation und Durchhaltevermögen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Was dich in der Rolle erwartet
Du verbindest systematisches Sourcing mit persönlicher Beziehungspflege und konsequenter Prozessführung. Dabei erhältst du die Möglichkeit, den M&A-Funnel aktiv mitzugestalten und Transaktionen in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld voranzubringen.

Wenn du M&A-Prozesse eigenständig vorantreibst, gern mit Gründerinnen und Gründern arbeitest und Erfahrung mit Small Caps mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte sende deinen Lebenslauf und - sofern verfügbar - eine kurze Übersicht relevanter Transaktionserfahrung.
wir bieten
Neben unserem hoch motivierten Team und einem erfolgreichen Produkt:

✓ Innovation mit Sicherheit: Bei uns trifft Start-up-Atmosphäre auf wirtschaftliche Stabilität.
✓ Work-Life-Balance: Wir fördern einen Arbeitsalltag frei von Überstunden, Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit.
✓ Diversität und Transparenz: Sei wie du bist. Ein offenes Arbeitsumfeld und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe erwarten dich.
✓ Fort- und Weiterbildung: Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an deinem Karriereweg bei uns.
✓ Weitere Benefits für dein Wohlbefinden: (virtuelle) Teamevents, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende, Sportangebote, Mentoring & Coaching, Gesundheits- sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge u. v. m.

description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Graubünden dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Contact Center Systems Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Contact Center Systems Engineer to support a large-scale, global enterprise contact center environment.
This role combines production support and platform engineering , including contact center routing, telephony troubleshooting, Linux-based systems, integrations, and migration from an existing commercial platform to a next-generation platform built on open-source telephony technologies.
Key Responsibilities

• Configure and maintain routing strategies, queues, IVR flows, and agent targeting across voice, chat, email, and task channels

• Troubleshoot production issues across telephony, network, and application layers

• Diagnose voice quality issues including latency, jitter, packet loss, codecs, and media-path problems

• Troubleshoot SIP/VoIP call flows and routing logic

• Support number provisioning, porting, and regional routing

• Analyze existing contact center configurations and map them to a new platform architecture

• Build and validate configurations in Linux environments

• Support platform migration and feature-parity testing

• Integrate systems using REST APIs and webhooks

• Participate in production incident triage and resolution

• Create technical documentation, runbooks, and structured shift handovers

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise Contact Center platforms

• Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Avaya, Cisco , or similar platforms

• Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, and VoIP

• Experience troubleshooting call flows, routing logic, and media-path issues

• Networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and QoS

• Strong Linux skills including service configuration, log analysis, and command-line troubleshooting

• Scripting/programming experience with Python, JavaScript, or Bash

• Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, Git, and deployment workflows

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting production systems

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, OpenSIPS, Asterisk , or similar open-source telephony technologies

• Contact center platform migration experience

• Experience with Wireshark, sngrep, sipgrep, or HOMER

• Terraform or Ansible

• Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog

• SQL fundamentals

• Cyara or other automated voice-testing platforms

• Exposure to AI-enabled contact center capabilities such as virtual agents, intent-based routing, or speech analytics

• ITIL / ITSM familiarity

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Analyst, Reporting
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Analyst, reporting to design, build, and maintain interactive client and internal dashboards while ensuring the underlying data meets strict accuracy and performance standards. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex raw data and visual insights, performing end-to-end data quality assurance, developing automated reports, and translating business requirements into clear analytical visuals.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and optimize interactive, production-grade dashboards and reports using BI tools Tableau, Power BI and Looker.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define KPI metrics and reporting requirements.

• Partner with growth, sales, and account teams to design compelling mockups, proof-of-concept (POC) dashboards, and data visual stories for new client pitches.

• Deliver fast-turnaround visual concepts that turn complex capabilities into easy-to-understand value propositions for external buyers.

• Maintain dashboard data models, automated refresh schedules, and row-level security for executive and operational dashboards.

• Support QA to identify data anomalies and collaborate with Data Engineering to remediate underlying source issues.

• Build and maintain a centralized data dictionary, KPI definition log, and technical documentation for all business reports.

• Support standardized guidelines for dashboard design, naming conventions, and data validation rules.
Qualifications:

• 0-2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles.

• Hands-on experience developing dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.

• Strong record of academic and/or professional achievement

• Sharp attention to UI/UX formatting, alignment, color consistency, and readability across dashboards.

• Data analysis experience including spreadsheet (Excel) and SQL platforms

• Effectiveness in managing multiple projects across multiple clients and stakeholders

• Understands user personas to design dashboards that non-technical users find intuitive and easy to adopt

• Familiarity with relational databases or cloud data warehouses

The annual gross base salary range is $50,000- $60,000 USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP 's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

title: Elektrokingenieur Instandhaltung & Wartung (m/w/d)
description:
Für einen etablierten Kunden suchen wir einen Elektrotechniker (m/w/d) in der Erdölindustrie, der die zuverlässige Funktion elektrischer Anlagen sicherstellt und ihre technische Weiterentwicklung begleitet. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Instandhaltung, Wartung und Ertüchtigung der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur für den Transport und die Lagerung von Erdöl. Sie arbeiten mit einem erfahrenen Team aus Elektrotechnik, Automatisierung und FacharbeiternInnen zusammen und bilden die Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen.
Aufgaben

Sie planen und koordinieren Instandhaltungs-, Wartungs- und Prüfmaßnahmen an elektrischen Anlagen - von der Niederspannung über die Mittelspannung bis zu ergänzenden Aufgaben im Hochspannungsbereich.
Sie analysieren technische Störungen, organisieren deren Behebung und entwickeln Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.Sie bereiten Projekte zur Ertüchtigung und Modernisierung bestehender Anlagen vor und begleiten deren Umsetzung.
Sie erstellen technische Aufgabenstellungen, wirken an Ausschreibungen mit und stimmen sich mit Einkauf, externen Dienstleistern und beteiligten Gewerken ab.
Sie koordinieren Arbeiten mit den Fachabteilungen und der Disposition, damit der laufende Transportbetrieb möglichst nicht beeinträchtigt wird.
Sie begleiten wiederkehrende Prüfungen und achten auf die Einhaltung der technischen Sicherheitsanforderungen, insbesondere im Bereich kathodischer Korrosionen und Explosionsschutz.

Qualifikation

Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation.
Sie bringen mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung mit, idealerweise mindestens drei Jahre in der Instandhaltung, Wartung oder Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Industrieanlagen.Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Niederspannungs-, und Mitteltechnik ( und Hochspannung von Vorteil) sowie im Umgang mit Schalta

title: RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist (Pipeline)
description:
About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC , we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

Location: This is a US-based remote position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Security Clearance: No security clearance required. Minimum active Tier 1 (or higher) federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain a CAC if required by duties.

Join Our Pipeline for Future Opportunities!

This posting is intended to establish a pool of qualified candidates for future openings supporting ongoing operations. Positions may become available based on staffing needs, operational requirements, or workforce changes. Qualified applicants may be contacted as opportunities arise.

Job Summary

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking an RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist to support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Walla Walla Business Intelligence (WWBI) program. This role owns cybersecurity compliance, Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and authorization artifacts, working closely with software developers, DevSecOps personnel, technical leadership, and Government stakeholders to ensure WWBI continuously complies with applicable Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. Army, USACE, and Civil Works Business Intelligence (CWBI) cybersecurity requirements. This position also supports maintenance of the WWBI authorization package and the program's planned migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual integration into the CWBI security boundary.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, update, and maintain WWBI Risk Management Framework authorization documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP), Incident Response Plan (IRP), System Design Documents, and related authorization artifacts.

• Manage and document program-specific security controls applicable to the WWBI system, and support security requirements associated with Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

• Maintain documentation defining the WWBI authorization boundary, including applicable hardware, software, ports, protocols, interfaces, and data flows.

• Coordinate cybersecurity documentation and compliance activities associated with WWBI's migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual incorporation into the CWBI authorization boundary.

• Maintain WWBI compliance records within the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), including uploading, mapping, organizing, and maintaining required RMF documentation, security-control evidence, implementation statements, and supporting artifacts.

• Support execution of the WWBI continuous-monitoring program, including coordinating and/or performing required ACAS and SCAP security scans, and maintaining a compliance score of at least 90% for applicable SCAP scans.

• Import and maintain security-scan results within DISA STIG Viewer and eMASS; analyze identified vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation activities with software developers and Government technical personnel.

• Track Critical and High findings for immediate remediation, Moderate findings for remediation within 60 days, and Low findings for remediation within 120 days; document approved exceptions and outstanding findings within the Plan of Actions and Milestones (POA&M).

• Develop, maintain, and submit the quarterly POA&M report detailing open, remediated, and outstanding security findings, and support quarterly updates to the RMF documentation package.

• Provide ACAS/SCAP scan results and associated STIG Viewer files following required scans, and maintain current system security, network topology, logical, and data-flow documentation in coordination

title: Sr. Director, Regulatory Affairs
description:
About Artiva
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies. Our mission is to develop effective, safe, and accessible cell therapies for patients with devastating autoimmune diseases. We aim to develop therapies that patients and physicians can utilize in a community setting. Our lead product candidate, AlloNK®, is a non-genetically modified, cryopreserved NK cell therapy being evaluated in combination with B-cell targeted monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). We believe the compelling cell-killing properties of NK cells, when combined with mAbs for targeting, create an opportunity to generate potentially transformative therapies.
For more information, visit

Apply your expertise across cell culture, aseptic processing, harvest and fill-finish, playing a direct role in advancing therapies for patients with autoimmune diseases.
For more information, visit .

The Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs is responsible for primary authorship and supporting regulatory activities, preparing regulatory submissions and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cell and gene-modified cell therapy, expertise in global regulatory requirements, and preferably late-stage development experience.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing regulatory requirements.

We are tenacious - we are laser-focused on our mission and undeterred in our commitment to make cell therapies broadly accessible to patients with autoimmune disease and cancer. title: Senior Algorithm Engineer - Sensing Algorithms
description:
The Company
Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

This is where a desire to make a difference in people's lives meets a passion for algorithm development and data science. The Algorithms team is at the very heart of what we do at Dexcom . voize is more than a scribe and far more than another documentation tool! We're defining & setting the benchmark what AI in healthcare actually looks like. As Product Manager - ML, you’ll sit at the core of our product, you’ll translate customer, Sales, and Customer Success signal into the ML product roadmap across our markets - defining what “better” means for our models, aligning stakeholders on priorities, and driving a shipping cadence that turns ML capability into measurable user value.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Own the ML product roadmap for core speech and NLP across our markets, turning field signal into clear priorities

- Run a structured customer-feedback → ML loop with Sales, Customer Support and Customer Success, and direct customer conversations (and close the loop back to the field)

- Define and maintain the model evaluation framework that gates releases (metrics, slices, thresholds, regression bar)

- Partner closely with Speech & NLP Leads as your roadmap counterparts to ship improvements to production

- Improve the product analytics and ML data integration: close the gaps between what we want to achieve, what we can measure in production, and what we train our models on.

- Own ML product KPIs (e.g., no-edit rate, documentation rate, edit rate per slot, transcription accuracy) and drive measurable improvements.

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- Extensive Experience in Product Management, background in speech recognition, NLP, or LLM-based product is a plus.

- Strong technical fluency in ML: evaluation, training data, latency/quality trade-offs, and release mechanics (you don’t need to train models, but you do need to deeply understand them)

- Track record of shipping ML-powered products to production with measurable user impact

- Hands-on experience designing and operationalizing ML model evaluation frameworks

- Excellent communication in English; German is required to lead customer and end-user conversations (roughly B2)

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le département d'Optique d'IMT Atlantique mène des recherches de pointe en photonique. Il s'appuie sur la plateforme technologique ARAGO, un espace d'expérimentation doté de salles blanches (ISO 5 & 6) dédié à la fabrication et à la caractérisation de dispositifs optiques innovants
Le poste vise à concevoir et développer des capteurs optiques de pesticides basés sur des cristaux liquides.

Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle, d’un responsable de la plateforme ARAGO, les missions sont :

· Exécuter des projets de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs à cristaux liquides
· Valoriser les résultats scientifiques des projets et promouvoir l'expertise technologique de la plateforme ARAGO.

ACTIVITÉS :

• Exécuter des projets de recherche dans le domaine des réflecteurs infrarouge

· Intervient en environnement de salle blanche ARAGO (ISO 5 & 6)
· Produit des encres électrophorétique IR
· Assure la fabrication et la caractérisation électrooptique complète des obturateurs.

2. Valoriser les résultats scientifiques des projets et promouvoir l'expertise technologique de la plateforme ARAGO.

· Participe au traitement, à la valorisation et à la diffusion des projets scientifiques et industriels auprès des publics et réseaux professionnels concernés (ex : publications, posters, preuves de concept, conseils aux entreprises, ...)
· Présente ses résultats et ceux des équipes
· Participe à la communication interne et externe afin d’améliorer la visibilité des projets
· Effectue une veille technologique et scientifique
· Valorise et de vulgarise la technologie portée par Arago.

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :
· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent
· Diplôme Bac + 4 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 4 ans
· Diplôme Bac + 3 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 6 ans
· Diplôme Bac + 2 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 10 ans

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité :
· Master ou ingénieur en physico-chimie

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :
· Compétence en technologies optiques
· Compétence en instrumentation optique
· Compétence en physico-chimie

Capacités et aptitudes :
· Appétence pour les liens avec l’industrie et l’application pratique de nouvelles technologies photoniques développées dans les laboratoires de recherche
· Dynamique, rigoureux et pragmatique avec de l'imagination et un sens pratique
· Curiosité scientifique et motivation à faire évoluer et améliorer l'environnement technologique.
· Disponibilité et goût du travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et de la recherche collaborative

👉 Écosystème d’innovation stimulant

title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience
description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform-where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Summary:
Every engineer pays a tax on slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, and tooling they have to work around. That tax compounds, and it’s paid by every team, every day, and it never shows up on a roadmap. This role exists to pay it down, so that everyone building software for legal teams can ship faster.
Today the largest known cost is the path from commit to production: GitLab CI for build, Octopus Deploy for release, across .NET, Python, and Svelte. That’s where you’ll start, and it isn’t where the job ends. The same mandate covers developer platform work, internal tooling, and purpose-built solutions for one team’s specific problem. What stays fixed is the measure: how much faster we ship, and how much friction you took out. You’ll have a strong hand in choosing the means. This is a senior individual contributor role, and your leverage comes from what you build and who you persuade.

Compensation Information: $190k - $230k
 
The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity - the range listed is just one component of Filevine’s total compensation package for employees. This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Work Location Expectation: Remote or option to be hybrid/in-office in one the following locations: San Francisco, New York, Chicago, or Salt Lake City
 
 
Cool Company Benefits:
- A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive 
- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
- Competitive & Fair Pay
- Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
- Short & long-term disability
- Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
- Top-of-the-line company swag
 
Privacy Policy Notice
Filevine will handle your personal information according to what’s outlined in our Privacy Policy.
 
Communication about this opportunity, or any open role at Filevine, will only come from representatives with email addresses using "filevine.com". Other addresses reaching out are not affiliated with Filevine and should not be responded to.

title: Product Manager (LATAM)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager for to join a globally distributed product and engineering team. The job is to turn business priorities into work engineers can pick up and ship, then stay with it through release.
This is hands on and execution first. You break the features them into requirements, sequenced plans and tickets that hold up under pressure. Day to day you're working with engineers, QA and business stakeholders, keeping projects moving and expectations honest.
There's room to grow. The product practice is still being built out, so discovery, PRDs, retrospectives and data informed prioritization are all things you'll be exposed to and can grow into over time.
Your first 6 months

• You own a portfolio of live projects end to end, from requirements through release, and everyone always knows where each one stands.

• Messy, multi part initiatives arrive from marketing, ops and customer experience, and you turn them into plans people can execute against.

• Your specs and acceptance criteria cut rework, with QA looped in early instead of at the end.

• You know the e-commerce stack, subscription flows and customer journeys well enough that engineers and stakeholders come to you first.

• You're contributing to sprint process, retros and planning cadence as the practice matures.

Who we're looking for

• 2-4 years in product management or technical project management. E-commerce or consumer products is a plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You write clear tickets, requirements and status updates, and you keep a distributed team aligned without endless back and forth.

• You chase ambiguity down rather than waiting on it, and you flag risk before it turns into a delay.

• Comfortable in Jira and Figma, at home with analytics tools. Shopify or other subscription commerce platforms a plus.

• Someone the team wants to work with. Much of this job is sitting between engineers and stakeholders, so being easy to collaborate with matters as much as process skill.

• Keen to grow as a PM, with mentorship and increasing ownership over time.

Engagement
Full time, remote, long term contract. Candidates based in South America with substantial overlap with US business hours.

title: Senior Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Governance

• Plan and coordinate all aspects of AIC projects (strategy/assessments, architecture/design, implementation/execution, and transition to operations) from initiation through closure.

• Ensure service delivery success, quality, and customer satisfaction through effective project and program management practices.

• Lead project initiation activities, including confirmation of client objectives, success metrics, scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and governance model .

• Develop, maintain, and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, work breakdown structures, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs .

• Own project administration in AHEAD ’s tools (e.g., PSA), ensuring accurate project setup, resource plans, budgets, billing milestones, and status updates.

• Apply change control and Project Change Request (PCR) processes for scope, schedule, and budget changes in collaboration with ELs, TLs, and Sales.
2. Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, driving clear and proactive communication with client stakeholders and internal leadership.

• Facilitate status meetings, steering committees, and executive-level updates , providing transparent views of progress, risks, decisions, and financial health.

• Align delivery with AIC and client standards (e.g., Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery), ensuring the ways-of-working are explicit and followed.

• Partner with Engagement Leads and Client Directors to shape a top-notch client experience , including responsiveness, expectation management, and structured escalation handling.
3. Coordination of Global & After-Hours Work

• Oversee and coordinate after-hours and weekend change windows (e.g., production cutovers, platform migrations, major releases) in partnership with US-based PMs and TLs.

• Act as the primary offshore liaison during change events when assigned, ensuring alignment with approved implementation plans, backout plans, and validation steps.

• Maintain continuous communication channels across time zones (India ↔ U.S.) so that risks, blockers, and status are clearly handed off and tracked.

• When no after-hours activities are scheduled, work aligned to India/U.S. overlap hours to independently lead small to medium AIC projects (e.g., cloud adoption pilots, data platform workstreams, application modernization sprints).
4. Risk, Quality, and Financial Management

• Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies , driving timely mitigation and escalation as needed.

• Ensure appropriate quality gates are defined and met (e.g., design reviews, test readiness, go/no-go, post-implementation reviews).

• Track and manage project budgets, burn rates, and margin , raising concerns early and partnering with ELs and practice leadership to protect both client value and profitability .

• Support PSA data hygiene by maintaining accurate time entry expectations, project end dates, budget adjustments, and revenue alignment.
5. Practice & PMO Enablement

• Model and reinforce AIC PMO standards for project hygiene, governance, and reporting, including use of standard templates, dashboards, and inspection routines.

• Contribute to practice development , including harvesting reusable artifacts (plans, RAID logs, status report templates, change playbooks) and improving delivery frameworks.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to junior project managers, coordinators, and consultants who are performing PM tasks on AIC engagements.

• Collaborate with Resource Management and Delivery leaders regarding resource planning and capacity management , helping to structure onshore/offshore staffing models that align to AIC scoping guidelines.
6. Pre-Sales & Opportunity Support (As Needed)

• Identify follow-on opportunities and work with client-facing teams to position next-phase work informed by project outcomes and client feedback.

title: Senior Director, Head of Analytical Development
description:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Director to lead Analytical Development across our small molecule and oligonucleotide portfolios. You will set the scientific direction, build the team, and ensure our methods, specifications, stability programs, and control strategies are ready for each stage of development, from pre-IND work through potential NDA/MAA approval.
This is a hands-on leadership role in a growing, agile organization. You will make consequential technical decisions, work closely with colleagues across Development CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Supply, and hold external partners to a high standard. Your work will help move promising molecules toward medicines for patients.
Primary Responsibilities

•
Set the analytical strategy. Define and execute an approach for drug substance and drug product across the small molecule and oligonucleotide portfolios. Make clear choices about what each program needs now and what it will need at the next clinical or regulatory milestone.

•
Build reliable methods and controls. Lead analytical method development, qualification, validation, transfer, and lifecycle management. Establish specifications, comparability approaches, and control strategies with Process Development, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs.

•
Deliver regulatory-ready science. Author and review analytical CMC content for IND, IMPD/CTA, and NDA/MAA submissions. Represent Analytical Development in health authority interactions and explain the science clearly under scrutiny.

•
Lead external execution. Oversee CDMOs, CROs, and contract testing laboratories, including method transfers, stability programs, and investigations of out-of-specification or out-of-trend results. Surface risks early and drive them to resolution.

•
Build the function. Hire, coach, and develop a strong analytical team. Shape its structure and capabilities as the portfolio grows, while giving people clear ownership and direct, useful feedback.

•
Connect the work to program decisions. Partner with Process Development, Formulation Development, Clinical Supply, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and program teams so analytical deliverables support sound decisions and meet program timelines. Lead CMC teams and represent CMC function on cross functional program teams.

•
Raise the standard. Champion data integrity, GMP compliance, and continuous improvement. Stay current with analytical technologies and regulatory expectations, and apply new approaches when they will improve the work.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• A Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Organic Chemistry, or a related field and 15+ years of relevant pharmaceutical or biotech experience; or an M.S./B.S. with commensurately greater experience.

• Deep experience developing and validating analytical methods and establishing control strategies for drug substance and drug product, from early development through late-stage or commercial readiness.

• Direct small molecule analytical development experience. Experience with ASO, siRNA, or other nucleic acid therapeutic analytics is strongly preferred.

• A record of authoring and defending analytical CMC content in regulatory filings and participating in health authority interactions.

• Experience directing CDMO/CRO relationships and outsourced analytical testing, with the judgment to identify issues and resolve them.

• People leadership experience and the ability to build a technical team in a growing organization.

• Strong working knowledge of ICH guidelines, USP/EP/JP compendial requirements, and current GMP regulations.

• Clear communication and sound judgment across scientific, operational, and executive discussions. Experience in CNS or rare disease development is a plus.

Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Client Engineering is the technical arm of Plaid’s European GTM team. - Debug integration issues hands-on with customer engineers across API, SDK, OAuth redirect, and webhook behaviour.

- Validate sandbox implementations and run go-live readiness checks.

- Use Plaid’s own data to proactively diagnose integration and conversion problems.

- Produce written handovers to Account Management and maintain the team’s reusable implementation resources.

- Escalate recurring integration failures to Product and Engineering as clear patterns, backed by evidence.

- Hands-on experience with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, JSON, and web and mobile SDKs.

- Comfort working in Postman or curl and reading API documentation critically.

- Experience with SQL or other data querying tools.

- A track record of owning technical projects end to end, with real deadlines and direct relationships with customer engineers.

- Clear written communication skills, including plans, handovers, and customer updates.

- Comfort working independently in a small regional team alongside a globally distributed function.

Nice-to-Haves

- Knowledge of open banking, including UK Open Banking, PSD2/PSD3, AIS/PIS, and VRP.

- Domain depth in payments, identity verification, or credit and underwriting.

- A formal technical background or prior software engineering experience.

- Experience with mobile integrations.

- Fluency in a second European language.

description:
Test Automation Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Test Automation Engineer
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range:  $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship : U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to bring strong software engineering practices to the discipline of test automation. In this role you will design, build, and continuously improve automation frameworks, write production-quality test code, and partner with development teams to embed quality engineering throughout the SDLC. The ideal candidate will combine strong programming skills with deep knowledge of testing strategy, including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing in modern distributed systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and build robust, scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, mobile, and microservice testing.

• Write production-quality automated test code in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C# using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Pact.

• Implement contract testing using Pact or similar tools to validate service contracts in microservice ecosystems.

• Build comprehensive CI/CD test pipelines integrated with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.

• Develop performance test suites using JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust, including realistic load models and result analysis.

• Implement security testing fundamentals including dependency scanning, SAST, DAST, and OWASP-based checks.

• Lead test strategy discussions, including risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and shift-left practices.

• Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to identify quality risks early.

• Perform root-cause analysis of production incidents, and translate findings into automated regression tests.

• Drive continuous improvement of test coverage, test reliability, and time-to-feedback.

• Mentor junior QA engineers and uphold engineering rigor in the testing community.

• Maintain comprehensive test documentation, traceability, and reporting dashboards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

• Contribute to internal testing tools and reusable libraries, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of experience as an SDET or in test-focused software engineering roles.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major UI automation framework (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).

• Solid experience automating REST and/or gR

Hi there!

We're looking for a Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join the State team at Zapier. We need someone who can set direction on our data infrastructure and isn’t afraid to get into the weeds to solve challenging operational problems.

The State team owns the platform behind Zapier's stateful services: our relational database fleet (MySQL and PostgreSQL), a caching layer built on Redis and ElastiCache, and the tooling that lets product teams use it all easily, safely, and reliably. You'll shape our practices around automation, observability, performance, reliability, and disaster recovery, and help make the right way the easy way for the teams building on top of our data layer. This is a senior DBRE role on the State team. You'll be the technical center of gravity for database and cache work: the person other engineers come to for design review, the one setting the bar for how we operate the data layer, and the one responsible for growing the DBRE practice on the team over time.

You have deep expertise in MySQL or PostgreSQL and working knowledge of the other, including each engine's ecosystem of extensions and tools. You know the cloud and treat infrastructure as code. You're comfortable operating stateful services alongside Kubernetes or other distributed systems, and you understand the tradeoffs of running data workloads in and around orchestrated environments.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
BridgePhase is a mission-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government. We empower agencies to achieve meaningful outcomes through high-performing software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and platform modernization solutions delivered by collaborative teams focused on innovation, adaptability, and operational excellence. As a trusted partner, BridgePhase helps Federal organizations modernize critical systems, accelerate delivery, and achieve lasting mission impact.
Position Overview:
BridgePhase is seeking an experienced, self-driven DevOps Engineer to support the operation, security, and continued optimization of enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform services within a FedRAMP-authorized Federal environment. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and compliance of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services while supporting platform governance, incident management, system upgrades, and ongoing operational improvements.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP or comparable large-scale enterprise cloud platforms, along with a solid understanding of cloud-native technologies, platform security, and service lifecycle management. This role requires a proactive technical leader who can take ownership of complex platform environments, troubleshoot critical issues, collaborate across engineering and security teams, and drive operational excellence in a highly regulated environment.
This position requires candidates to be U.S. citizens who hold no additional citizenship. This is a fully remote role with the potential for conversion to a permanent position after one year. The interview process includes an initial Microsoft Teams interview followed by an onsite interview in Herndon, VA. Participation in an on-call rotation to support production services is required.
Key Responsibilities:

• Own the day-to-day operations, reliability, availability, and performance of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services across multiple environments within a FedRAMP-authorized cloud infrastructure.

• Serve as a primary technical resource and escalation point for platform operations, ensuring service continuity, security, and compliance with federal requirements.

• Maintain comprehensive visibility into BTP services, subaccounts, directories, entitlements, global account configurations, and platform dependencies.

• Establish and enforce operational standards, configuration baselines, change management procedures, and governance policies aligned with federal security and compliance requirements.

• Monitor platform health, service availability, performance metrics, integration throughput, and error rates using approved monitoring and observability tools.

• Manage service-level agreements (SLAs), proactively identify operational risks, and implement solutions to maintain platform reliability and minimize service disruptions.

• Lead incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for platform outages, service degradations, and complex integration issues, coordinating remediation efforts across technical teams.

• Develop, maintain, and regularly validate business continuity and disaster recovery plans, operational runbooks, and incident response procedures for critical platform services.

• Plan, coordinate, test, and execute platform upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities in alignment with SAP release schedules and federal change control requirements.

• Evaluate SAP security advisories, release notes, and patch updates to identify vulnerabilities, prioritize remediation, and ensure platform configurations remain secure and compliant.

• Coordinate pre-production validation, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities to minimize operational risks

title: Debt Collector
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical, proactive, and tech-savvy Commercial Collections & UCC Research Specialist to support commercial debt recovery, business investigations, and operational case management.
This role combines three key functions: commercial collections and payment negotiations, UCC/DCC research and enforcement support, and administrative operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for communicating with debtors, negotiating payment arrangements, investigating business relationships, identifying potential recovery opportunities, and maintaining accurate case documentation.
The ideal candidate is confident handling sensitive financial conversations, skilled at uncovering relevant business information, and capable of using technology and AI tools to improve research and operational efficiency. They must be resourceful, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex cases independently with minimal supervision.
Candidates must demonstrate relevant practical experience. General customer service, call centre, or administrative experience alone will not be sufficient
Requirements
Key Responsibilities
1. Commercial Collections & Negotiations

• Contact debtors to discuss outstanding financial obligations and negotiate payment arrangements.

• Communicate firmly, professionally, and respectfully while working towards practical collection outcomes.

• Explain financial obligations and payment requirements clearly.

• Manage challenging conversations while maintaining professional relationships.

• Conduct timely follow-ups on outstanding payments and agreed payment arrangements.

• Document collection activities, negotiation outcomes, and next steps accurately.

• Follow all applicable collection laws, regulations, and client-approved procedures.

2. UCC/DCC Research & Enforcement Support

• Conduct investigative research into debtors, their businesses, and their commercial relationships.

• Identify companies, customers, or third parties that may owe money to debtors and could represent potential recovery opportunities.

• Research corporate connections, business relationships, and relevant commercial information using online sources and business research tools.

• Analyse findings to identify potential leads for further investigation or recovery action.

• Prepare professional correspondence and supporting documentation in line with client-approved procedures.

• Organise research findings clearly and accurately for review and appropriate next steps.

• Follow established legal and compliance procedures when supporting UCC/DCC-related enforcement activities.

3. Operations & Case Management

• Maintain accurate spreadsheets, case records, research findings, and supporting documentation.

• Track collection activities, deadlines, follow-ups, and case progress.

• Use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to organise, analyse, and manage case information.

• Maintain clear and structured records within CRM systems and document management platforms.

• Use AI tools to support research, summarise information, organise findings, and improve workflow efficiency.

• Manage multiple cases and competing priorities without compromising accuracy.

• Identify operational issues, investigate discrepancies, and recommend practical solutions.

• Provide clear updates and reports on case progress, research outcomes, and outstanding actions.

Minimum Requirements

• Relevant experience in commercial collections, debt recovery, payment negotiations, investigative research, or financial operations.

• Demonstrated ability to negotiate payments firmly and professionally.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong investigative research and analytical abilities.

• Ability to identify relevant business relationships and potential third-party payment obligations.

• Strong problem-solving skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and Go

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable data solutions for the Manufacturing BI team, including data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, databases, APIs, data models, and Power BI reporting solutions. The role works closely with business and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing data solutions.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Python, SQL, and Microsoft Fabric.

• Design and develop solutions using Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse.

• Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, databases, and data models.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $7 billion in revenue. At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej organizacji notowanej na NASDAQ w Sztokholmie, działającej w 11 krajach. W Polsce mamy pełną autonomię. Sami wybieramy technologie, procesy i sposób pracy, zachowując najwyższe standardy.
Realizujemy różnorodne projekty IT w Polsce i globalnie, w wielu obszarach i technologiach, co pozwala rozwijać kompetencje i zdobywać doświadczenie dopasowane do Twoich ambicji.
Naszą współpracę opieramy na filozofii CARE. Rozumiemy ją jako odpowiedzialny dobór projektów, transparentną współpracę oraz długofalowe podejście do rozwoju.
Dołącz do nas jako Forward Deployed Engineer i rozwijaj się w środowisku, które myśli o Twoim rozwoju tak samo, jak Ty.
Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) prowadzą złożone, kompleksowe wdrożenia modeli generatywnych (frontier models) w środowisku produkcyjnym, razem z naszymi najważniejszymi klientami. Odpowiadasz za cały proces: discovery, zakres techniczny, projekt systemu, budowę i wdrożenie produkcyjne. Pracujesz bezpośrednio z zespołami inżynierskimi i domenowymi klienta.
Sukces mierzymy adopcją na produkcji, wymiernym wpływem na procesy pracy oraz feedbackiem opartym na ewaluacji (eval-driven), który realnie zmienia roadmapy produktu i modeli.
Twoje zadania:

• Odpowiadać za dostarczenie technicznej części wielu wdrożeń, od pierwszego prototypu po stabilną produkcję.

• Budować systemy full-stack, które dają klientowi realną wartość i pomagają nam szybciej się uczyć.

• Pracować blisko zespołów klienta, rozumieć ich potrzeby i prowadzić ich przez adopcję rozwiązania.

• Definiować zakres prac, planować kolejność dostaw i wcześnie usuwać blokery.

• Podejmować decyzje w trójkącie zakres, tempo, jakość oraz korygować plan tak, by zabezpieczyć dostawę.

• Pisać kod samodzielnie, gdy od tego zależy postęp lub klarowność.

• Przekształcać sprawdzone sposoby pracy w narzędzia, playbooki i gotowe klocki dla innych.

• Przekazywać feedback z pola zespołom Research i Product: gdzie modele sprawdzają się dobrze, a gdzie można je poprawić.

• Dbać o płynność pracy zespołów przez jasną komunikację i konsekwencję w działaniu.

Dobrze się u nas odnajdziesz, jeśli:

• Masz 5+ lat doświadczenia w inżynierii lub wdrożeniach technicznych, z elementem pracy z klientem.

• Planowałeś/-aś i dowoziłeś/-aś złożone systemy w dynamicznym, niejednoznacznym środowisku.

• Piszesz i recenzujesz kod produkcyjny we frontendzie i backendzie (Python, JavaScript lub podobne stosy).

• Budowałeś/-aś lub wdrażałeś/-aś systemy oparte na LLM-ach lub modelach generatywnych i rozumiesz, jak zachowanie modelu wpływa na doświadczenie użytkownika.

• Upraszczasz złożone problemy i szybko podejmujesz trafne decyzje pod presją.

• Komunikujesz się jasno z inżynierami, zespołami produktowymi i interesariuszami klienta.

• Wcześnie dostrzegasz ryzyka i reagujesz bez spowalniania zespołu.

• Musisz mieszkać i/lub posiadać uprawnienia do pracy w Polsce.

• Masz poziom języka polskiego minimum B2, a angielskiego B2+/C1.

Co oferujemy?

• Współpracę projektową lub zadaniową, w elastycznym wymiarze godzin.

• Współpracę w skandynawskiej kulturze opartej o logikę i dialog.

• Treningi sportowe, wewnętrzna drużyna, wspólne zawody.

• Imprezy integracyjne i spotkania rozwojowe.
